description: This PHP class handles Stripe subscription and donation requests within the Omnipay Stripe integration, including creating checkout sessions, retrieving and updating subscriptions, and generating metadata for investments and projects.

classes.name: SubscriptionRequest
classes.description: Handles Stripe subscription and donation requests, including creating checkout sessions, completing purchases, and managing metadata related to investments and projects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SubscriptionRequest with data and Stripe client.

methods.name: sendData
methods.description: Creates a Stripe checkout session for a subscription based on user and investment data.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Completes the purchase process by retrieving and updating the Stripe checkout session and handling donations.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for redirection based on provided path segments.

methods.name: getInvestReward
methods.description: Retrieves the reward ID for an investment or returns a default string.

methods.name: getStripeCustomer
methods.description: Searches for an existing Stripe customer by email or creates a new one.

methods.name: getStripeProduct
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Stripe product associated with an investment.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Generates metadata array for an investment.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Determines the product ID based on whether the investment has a project.

methods.name: getProductWithProjectId
methods.description: Creates a product ID string including project ID, reward, and user ID.

methods.name: getProductWithoutProjectId
methods.description: Creates a product ID string without project ID, based on investment ID and user ID.

methods.name: getStripeCurrency
methods.description: Determines the currency for Stripe transactions based on project or user preferences.
